caseNameFull: Clarence E. Collins, in Error v. State of New Hampshire
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Hew Hampshire.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. D. Guthrie and Mr. A. H. Veeder for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Eclwm G. Eastman for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Judgment affirmed, with costs, by an equally divided court.
